description: The words a capability design uses that are not Features (metamodel/design/design-catalog.md, docs/MDE-Unified-Features-Proposal.md section 8): the verbs of an operation, and the model properties of an entity. Defined once by the Method; an application's catalog does not redefine them.

sets.description: The operation fills these values itself, such as when a request was submitted.

options.fields: attributes, as Entity.attribute when on another entity

records.description: What the user gives for this operation, such as a reason, is kept with the status history.

delegates.description: This operation also carries out another one, with that one's checks, as one change.

options.when: a condition, if it applies only sometimes

locks.description: Related records are held still while the operation checks and writes.

options.entities: the entities whose rows are locked

decision.description: One action with several outcomes, each with its own result; some outcomes need a reason.

options.reasonRequiredFor: the outcomes that need a reason

default.description: An optional input that is filled in when left empty.

internal.description: Only the system does this, as part of other operations; it is never exposed.

unique.description: No two records may share these values.

index.description: The lists and work queues people use stay fast.

check.description: The database itself refuses a record that breaks this condition.

label.description: How a record is named to people, everywhere it appears.
